Interface WordSource

All Known Implementing Classes:
WordSource.FromValue, WordSource.FromValueHigh, WordSource.FromValueLow, WordSource.Immediate, WordSource.StringAddress
public sealed interface WordSource permits WordSource.FromValue, WordSource.FromValueLow, WordSource.FromValueHigh, WordSource.StringAddress, WordSource.Immediate
One argument word of a call: Juno's calling convention passes every argument as 32-bit words, in order.

    static List<WordSource>
    argumentWords(List<Value> arguments)
    Every 32-bit word an argument list passes, in order: a long/double contributes its low then high word, matching the JVM's two local slots in the callee's parameter spill.
